fixed_contract.keyword_policy: All four original target positions of every known positive occurrence of BOTH keywords; preserve repeated occurrences and all other fulltext tokens.
fixed_contract.score_policy: Raw unweighted full-sequence CTC log probability; deletion candidates differ in length and are analytic alternatives, never new labels.

interpretation_limits: This is posthoc descriptive analysis after the original computation and saved-output audit; it is not an added experiment or part of the original frozen terminal calculation.

A hit means at least one complete contiguous occurrence in the saved greedy row, not every reference mention. Hit-row groups still retain every reference mention, including any omitted mention in the same row.

Row-level full-reference versus saved-greedy differences count each row once within its model/split/offset group. Token-deletion contrasts and conditional supports count each original reference mention and each of its four positions.
The three offsets and two models on the same source are repeated conditions, not independent examples. No confidence interval, hypothesis test, threshold or winner is selected here.

Log P(original) minus log P(single-deletion) is only a pairwise sequence preference. Candidates differ in length; neither is guaranteed the globally preferred transcription. It does not prove a production decoder failed.

Normalized conditional target occupancy must place the weak-reference token. It is not the probability that a syllable was spoken. Raw full-vocabulary class probability and margins are model-output support, not acoustic ground truth.

The Viterbi blank gap belongs to one optimal forced-reference state path. Actual argmax blank counts are reported separately; neither is a human timing annotation. Missing leading/trailing target-neighbor gaps remain missing rather than zero.

Full TTS pronunciation, weak-label correctness, unobserved source factors and model-input quality remain unresolved without a separately specified human listening review. Exposed development stays development.

All four positions of both keyword definitions and repeated mentions are retained. No labels, weights, splits, thresholds, decoder or training settings are changed. No human-gold, independent-test or generalization claim follows.
posthoc.keyword_hit_definition: Per row, at least one complete contiguous keyword occurrence in saved greedy; not every reference mention.
posthoc.mention_metric_definition: Single-deletion contrasts and conditional support count every original reference mention and each of four positions.
posthoc.row_metric_definition: Original minus saved-greedy log probability counts each row once within model/split/offset.
